name: BetterGH3
summary: BetterGH3 is an all-in-one package that gives you the definitive near-vanilla console experience in one portable, easy-to-install bundle. This is for PC, just extract it and run it! This package includes a portable install of Guitar Hero III, all the DLC (including console exclusives), a custom patch, GH3+ with some new plugins, online play via the Warehouse custom server, as well as some additional fixes including Borderless Windowed mode and automatic FPS capping (or unlimited FPS if you prefer). Also, most guitar controllers are supported!
